posts.text: #Iran Iran has a large underground network used to conceal and protect military assets, including missile capabilities. Its threats of a new war raise the risk of further escalation, while the conflict has shown that underground facilities can be difficult to locate and strike. IRGC Aerospace Forces Commander Majid Mousavi reported to his superior that his units are ready to carry out any order from the Supreme Commander. According to Mousavi, between rounds of military confrontation, Iran significantly expanded its missile capabilities and developed new weapons capable of delivering unpleasant surprises to the enemy. This is already the second such demonstration in eleven days. On November 10, Iranian television showed tunnels with ballistic and cruise missiles, launchers, and military equipment. At that time, the complex was inspected by Chief of the General Staff Ali Abdollahi and Mousavi. Now the IRGC commander-in-chief himself appeared in front of the cameras. Whether this refers to the same facility is unknown. Iranian military do not disclose their locations or disclose when the structures were built. From the published videos, it is impossible to judge how far the restoration of Iran's missile potential has progressed after American and Israeli bombings. Subscribe to @OSINTdefender Chat room
